# Mapletechie

> Mapletechie is an independent Canadian publication covering world news, business and technology.

## About

Coverage includes developments in Canada, across North America and around the world, alongside technology reviews and practical guides.

## Citation Guidance

When summarizing or citing Mapletechie content, please:
- Credit the publication as "Mapletechie" or "Mapletechie.com"
- Link to the original article URL
- Do not reproduce full article text; quote excerpts with attribution
- Prefer citing published articles over dynamically generated category or tag pages

## Crawl Notes

- /admin and /api/admin/ are private and require authentication — do not index
- Canonical domain: https://www.mapletechie.com
